name: canvas-crowd
title: Canvas Crowd
description: A canvas strip of sketchy black-and-white people walking across the bottom of the screen. Characters enter from both sides at different depths and leave, so the crowd keeps cycling, with a small label centred above.
use: A community or launch page wants a lively human crowd as decoration without photos.
avoid: It loads a remote sprite sheet from an external bucket and draws continuously, which costs battery.
a11y: The canvas is decorative and silent, and the endless walk ignores reduced-motion, so it keeps moving for users who ask it not to. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A stark black background with a thick horizontal band of black-and-white line-drawn figures along the bottom edge. The people differ in hats, hair and posture, drawn at several depths so heads overlap, and a tiny grey label sits at the top centre.
behaves: Each figure walks across the strip at its own pace with a slight bob, then leaves and respawns from the opposite side or another depth. The crowd keeps cycling so the band stays full.
customise: Props set the sprite sheet URL and the small label; the rows and columns, walk speed and crowd density are fixed in the source.
weight: heavy: Paints up to 105 sprite figures to a canvas every frame from the GSAP ticker.
